KNIRVSHELL · PORTABLE DVE · WASM-NATIVE
172:

DVE Pod

173:

A Decentralized Virtual Environment delivered through the knirv CLI — runs anywhere, trusts nothing it can't prove, and escalates capability as trust is established.

174:
175: KNIRVSHELL Embedded 176: TinyGo + WASI 177: Auto Runtime Install 178: WebCrypto TEE 179: knirv dve pod 180: Single-File Bundle 181:
182:

DESIGN DECISION
187:

Why This Approach

188:

Three candidate designs were evaluated. The chosen approach — a WASI-native WASM module with a browser JS host and optional CLI runtime — wins on every axis.

189: 190:
191:
192:
✓
193:

DVE Pod via KNIRVSHELL (chosen)

194:

TinyGo → WASM/WASI binary embedded inside the knirv CLI. KNIRVSHELL auto-detects or installs a WASM runtime, then exposes clean knirv dve pod commands — no runtime plumbing visible to the user.

195:
196:
197:
✗
198:

iFrame Proxy

199:

iFrame into a remote KNIRVSERVER DVE. Simple but requires constant network, exposes server URL, no offline capability, no portability — just a thin wrapper.

200:
201:
202:
✗
203:

Full Go WASM Bundle

204:

Compile entire KNIRVSERVER stack to WASM. Binary would be 40MB+, Go WASM runtime overhead is severe, and most server logic (eBPF, SGX, P2P) can't run client-side.

KNIRVSHELL (knirv) — Entry Point

The knirv binary embeds dvepod.wasm via //go:embed. On first knirv dve pod call, it checks for Wasmer/Wasmtime in PATH; if absent, auto-downloads and installs Wasmer. All WASM runtime invocations are internal — users only see knirv commands.

SYSTEM DESIGN
247:

Architecture

248:

KNIRVSHELL is the distribution vehicle. The knirv binary carries dvepod.wasm inside it, manages the WASM runtime lifecycle, and surfaces clean knirv dve pod subcommands. The WASM core itself is host-agnostic — the same binary also powers the browser HTML bundle.

// cmd/dvepod/main.go — TinyGo WASI entrypoint
398: // Build: tinygo build -target=wasi -o dvepod.wasm ./cmd/dvepod/
399: // Run browser: open dvepod.html
400: // Run CLI:     wasmer run dvepod.wasm

402: package main
403: 
404: import (
405:     "bufio"
406:     "fmt"
407:     "os"
408:     "strings"

410:     "github.com/knirv/dvepod/internal/agent"

416: func main() {
417:     ctx, _ := tee.NewContext()    // generates P-256 identity, measures WASM hash
418:     bb  := tools.NewBusyBox(ctx)   // registers 20+ BusyBox commands
419:     ag  := agent.New(ctx)           // KNIRVAGENT: solo by default, upgrades on dock
420:     sh  := shell.New(ctx, bb, ag)   // line-editing shell with history
421: 
422:     sh.Boot()                        // print boot banner, perform self-attestation
423: 
424:     scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
425:     for {
426:         fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, sh.Prompt())
427:         if !scanner.Scan() { break }
428:         sh.Exec(scanner.Text())
429:     }
430: }

432: // internal/shell/shell.go — command dispatcher
433: type Shell struct {
434:     ctx     *tee.Context
435:     bb      *tools.BusyBox
436:     agent   *agent.KNIRVAgent
437:     cwd     string
438:     history []string
439:     env     map[string]string
440:     mode    string   // "solo" | "tethered" | "bridged"
441:     dockURL string
442: }
443: 
444: func (s *Shell) Exec(line string) {
445:     line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
446:     if line == "" { return }
447:     s.history = append(s.history, line)
448: 
449:     parts := shell.ParseLine(line)    // handles quotes, escapes, pipes
450:     cmd, args := parts[0], parts[1:]
451: 
452:     switch cmd {
453:     // BusyBox built-ins
454:     case "ls", "cat", "echo", "mkdir", "rm", "cp", "mv",
455:          "env", "pwd", "ps", "curl", "grep", "wc", "find",
456:          "chmod", "whoami", "date", "df", "free", "uname":
457:         out, err := s.bb.Run(cmd, args, s.cwd, s.env)
458:         s.print(out, err)
459: 
460:     // DVE-specific commands
461:     case "tee":   s.cmdTEE(args)
462:     case "agent": s.cmdAgent(args)
463:     case "dock":  s.cmdDock(args)
464:     case "net":   s.cmdNet(args)
465:     case "nrn":   s.cmdNRN(args)
466:     case "export":s.cmdExport(args)
467:     case "help":  s.cmdHelp()
468:     case "clear": fmt.Print("\033[2J\033[H")
469:     default:
470:         fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dvepod: %s: command not found\n", cmd)
471:     }
472: }
473: 
474: func (s *Shell) cmdDock(args []string) {
475:     if len(args) == 0 {
476:         fmt.Println("usage: dock <knirvserver-url> [--node-id <id>]")
477:         return
478:     }
479:     s.dockURL = args[0]
480:     s.agent.SetEndpoint(s.dockURL)   // upgrades from solo → tethered
481:     s.mode = "tethered"
482: 
483:     // Present our attestation to the server, get a chain session ID
484:     att, _ := s.ctx.Attest()
485:     sid, err := s.agent.Register(att)
486:     if err != nil {
487:         fmt.Printf("\033[31m✗ dock failed: %v\033[0m\n", err)
488:         return
489:     }
490:     s.env["CHAIN_SESSION_ID"] = sid
491:     s.mode = "bridged"
492:     fmt.Printf("\033[32m✓ docked to %s (session: %s)\033[0m\n", args[0], sid[:12])
493: }

// dvepod-host.js — WASI browser host (inlined in dvepod.html)
498: // Bridges WASM WASI syscalls to browser APIs.
499: 
500: class DVEPodHost {
501:   constructor(terminal) {
502:     this.term     = terminal;        // xterm.js Terminal instance
503:     this.opfs     = null;            // Origin Private File System root
504:     this.stdinBuf = '';             // line buffer from xterm input
505:     this.stdinRes = null;           // pending stdin Promise resolver
506:     this.decoder  = new TextDecoder();
507:     this.encoder  = new TextEncoder();
508:   }
509: 
510:   async init() {
511:     // Acquire OPFS root — persistent, quota-managed, sandboxed
512:     this.opfs = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
513:     await this.ensureDir('home/dvepod');
514:     await this.ensureDir('home/dvepod/.knirv');
515:     await this.ensureDir('home/dvepod/workspace');
516:     await this.ensureDir('var/run/knirv');
517:     await this.ensureDir('tmp');
518: 
519:     return this.wasiImports();     // pass to WebAssembly.instantiate
520:   }
521: 
522:   wasiImports() {
523:     return {
524:       wasi_snapshot_preview1: {
525:         // stdout → xterm.js
526:         fd_write: (fd, iovs, iovsLen, nwritten) => {
527:           if (fd !== 1 && fd !== 2) return 8;
528:           const view = new DataView(this.memory.buffer);
529:           let written = 0;
530:           for (let i = 0; i < iovsLen; i++) {
531:             const ptr = view.getUint32(iovs + i * 8, true);
532:             const len = view.getUint32(iovs + i * 8 + 4, true);
533:             const bytes = new Uint8Array(this.memory.buffer, ptr, len);
534:             this.term.write(this.decoder.decode(bytes));
535:             written += len;
536:           }
537:           view.setUint32(nwritten, written, true);
538:           return 0;
539:         },
540: 
541:         // stdin ← xterm.js keystrokes (line-buffered)
542:         fd_read: (fd, iovs, iovsLen, nread) => {
543:           // Returns EAGAIN; real input pumped via SharedArrayBuffer or postMessage
544:           return 6; // EAGAIN — async model handled via Atomics.wait
545:         },
546: 
547:         // OPFS-backed filesystem ops
548:         path_open:   (...args) => this.opfsOpen(...args),
549:         fd_close:    (fd)      => this.opfsClose(fd),
550:         path_create_directory: (...a) => this.opfsMkdir(...a),
551:         path_filestat_get:     (...a) => this.opfsStat(...a),
552: 
553:         // Environment
554:         environ_sizes_get: (countPtr, sizePtr) => this.envSizes(countPtr, sizePtr),
555:         environ_get: (envPtr, bufPtr)           => this.envGet(envPtr, bufPtr),
556: 
557:         // Randomness (WebCrypto → WASM)
558:         random_get: (bufPtr, bufLen) => {
559:           const buf = new Uint8Array(this.memory.buffer, bufPtr, bufLen);
560:           crypto.getRandomValues(buf);
561:           return 0;
562:         },
563: 
564:         proc_exit: (code) => { throw new WebAssembly.RuntimeError(`exit(${code})`); },
565:         clock_time_get: (id, prec, timePtr) => {
566:           const view = new DataView(this.memory.buffer);
567:           view.setBigUint64(timePtr, BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000000n, true);
568:           return 0;
569:         },
570:       }
571:     };
572:   }
573: 
574:   // Feed xterm keystrokes into WASM stdin via SharedArrayBuffer
575:   feedStdin(data) {
576:     this.stdinBuf += data;
577:     if (this.stdinRes && this.stdinBuf.includes('\n')) {
578:       const res = this.stdinRes;
579:       this.stdinRes = null;
580:       res();
581:     }
582:   }
583: }

// internal/tee/tee.go — TEE simulation layer
588: // Browser mode:  P-256 keypair via WebCrypto (WASM interop call)
589: // SGX mode:      real quote generation via go-sgx-quote library
590: // SNP mode:      AMD SEV attestation via /dev/sev-guest
591: // Wasmer mode:   software attestation (WASM binary hash + host fingerprint)
592: 
593: package tee
594: 
595: import (
596:     "crypto/rand"
597:     "crypto/sha256"
598:     "encoding/hex"
599:     "encoding/json"
600:     "os"
601:     "time"
602: )
603: 
604: type Context struct {
605:     NodeID      string    `json:"node_id"`
606:     TEEType     string    `json:"tee_type"`      // browser-wasm|wasmer|sgx|sev-snp|tdx
607:     WASMHash    string    `json:"wasm_hash"`     // SHA-256 of this exact binary
608:     PublicKey   []byte    `json:"public_key"`
609:     Measurement string    `json:"measurement"`   // TEE PCR equivalent
610:     CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
611: }
612: 
613: func NewContext() (*Context, error) {
614:     // Measure this WASM binary — proves integrity of the runtime
615:     wasmBytes, _ := os.ReadFile("/proc/self/exe")
616:     hash := sha256.Sum256(wasmBytes)
617: 
618:     // Generate ephemeral identity or load persisted keypair
619:     nodeIDBytes := make([]byte, 16)
620:     rand.Read(nodeIDBytes)
621: 
622:     ctx := &Context{
623:         NodeID:      "dvepod-" + hex.EncodeToString(nodeIDBytes[:8]),
624:         TEEType:     detectTEEType(),
625:         WASMHash:    hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]),
626:         Measurement: deriveMeasurement(hash[:]),
627:         CreatedAt:   time.Now(),
628:     }
629:     ctx.PublicKey = generateOrLoadKey(ctx.NodeID)
630:     return ctx, nil
631: }
632: 
633: func (c *Context) Attest() (Attestation, error) {
634:     payload := map[string]interface{}{
635:         "node_id":     c.NodeID,
636:         "tee_type":    c.TEEType,
637:         "wasm_hash":   c.WASMHash,
638:         "measurement": c.Measurement,
639:         "public_key":  hex.EncodeToString(c.PublicKey),
640:         "timestamp":   time.Now().Unix(),
641:         "version":     "dvepod/1.0",
642:     }
643:     data, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
644:     sig := sign(data, c.NodeID)   // ECDSA P-256 signature via JS interop (browser)
645:                                     // or crypto/ecdsa (WASI CLI)
646:     return Attestation{Payload: payload, Signature: sig}, nil
647: }
648: 
649: // Server-side verification: packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/internal/web/dve_pod_handler.go
650: // POST /api/dve/pod/register  →  validates attestation, creates lightweight DVECreation
651: func VerifyPodAttestation(att Attestation) error {
652:     // 1. Verify signature against claimed public key
653:     // 2. Check wasm_hash against known good hashes (registry)
654:     // 3. For tee_type=sgx: forward to Intel Attestation Service
655:     // 4. For tee_type=browser-wasm: accept with reduced trust level (L1 only)
656:     // 5. Issue chain session ID → return to pod
657:     return verifyECDSA(att.Payload, att.Signature)
658: }

// Storage architecture: three-tier persistence
663: //
664: // Tier 1: OPFS (Origin Private File System)
665: //   - Exposed to WASM as virtual WASI filesystem
666: //   - Persistent across browser sessions, up to browser storage quota
667: //   - Directory: /home/dvepod/, /var/run/knirv/, /tmp/
668: //   - Used for: workspace files, config, agent artifacts
669: //
670: // Tier 2: IndexedDB (structured data)
671: //   - Command history, agent chat history, session metadata
672: //   - Key: dvepod-{nodeId}-{table}
673: //   - Not exposed to WASM directly; accessed via JS bridge call
674: //
675: // Tier 3: In-memory (WASM linear memory)
676: //   - Active process state, environment variables, pipe buffers
677: //   - Lost on page reload; bootstrapped from Tier 1 on startup

306: 	cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
307: 	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr

330: func wasmerReleaseURL(goos, goarch string) string {
331: 	archMap := map[string]string{
332: 		"amd64": "amd64",
333: 		"arm64": "aarch64",
334: 		"arm":   "armv7",
335: 	}
336: 	arch, ok := archMap[goarch]
337: 	if !ok {
338: 		arch = "amd64"
339: 	}
340: 
341: 	ext := "tar.gz"
342: 	if goos == "windows" {
343: 		ext = "zip"
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	return fmt.Sprintf("https://github.com/wasmerio/wasmer/releases/download/v5.0.0/wasmer-linux-%s.%s", arch, ext)
347: }

349: func downloadAndExtract(url, dest string) error {
350: 	resp, err := http.Get(url)
351: 	if err != nil {
352: 		return fmt.Errorf("download failed: %w", err)
353: 	}
354: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
355: 
356: 	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
357: 		return fmt.Errorf("download failed (HTTP %d)", resp.StatusCode)
358: 	}
359: 
360: 	tmpFile := filepath.Join(dest, "wasmer.tar.gz")
361: 	f, err := os.Create(tmpFile)
362: 	if err != nil {
363: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp file: %w", err)
364: 	}
365: 
366: 	_, err = io.Copy(f, resp.Body)
367: 	f.Close()
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		os.Remove(tmpFile)
370: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to download: %w", err)
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	wasmerBin := filepath.Join(dest, "wasmer")
374: 	if _, err := os.Stat(wasmerBin); err == nil {
375: 		os.Remove(tmpFile)
376: 		return nil
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, wasmerBin); err != nil {
380: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to install wasmer: %w", err)
381: 	}
382: 
383: 	if err := os.Chmod(wasmerBin, 0755); err != nil {
384: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to make wasmer executable: %w", err)
385: 	}
386: 
387: 	os.Remove(tmpFile)
388: 	return nil
389: }

391: func base64Encode(data []byte) string {
392: 	const chars = "REDACTED/"
393: 	var result strings.Builder
394: 	for i := 0; i < len(data); i += 3 {
395: 		var b [3]byte
396: 		var n int
397: 		for j := 0; j < 3 && i+j < len(data); j++ {
398: 			b[j] = data[i+j]
399: 			n = j + 1
400: 		}
401: 		val := uint(b[0])<<16 | uint(b[1])<<8 | uint(b[2])
402: 		result.WriteByte(chars[(val>>18)&0x3F])
403: 		result.WriteByte(chars[(val>>12)&0x3F])
404: 		if n > 1 {
405: 			result.WriteByte(chars[(val>>6)&0x3F])
406: 		} else {
407: 			result.WriteByte('=')
408: 		}
409: 		if n > 2 {
410: 			result.WriteByte(chars[val&0x3F])
411: 		} else {
412: 			result.WriteByte('=')
413: 		}
414: 	}
415: 	return result.String()
416: }

1. Add `POST /dve/pod/{id}/attest` route to `RegisterRoutes`
2. Add `AttestPod` handler that upgrades the trust level
3. Add a `TrustLevel` field to `PodSession`
4. Add corresponding test

Let me also look at what trust levels exist. From the spec table:
- "wasi" → basic (L0)
- "browser-wasm" → level with browser (L1)
- "sgx", "sev-snp", "tdx" → hardware TEE (L3)

The attest endpoint upgrades from a lower trust level (e.g., "wasi") to a higher one (e.g., "sgx") by providing new attestation evidence.

func (h *DVEPodHandler) RegisterRoutes(r *mux.Router) {
	sub := r.PathPrefix("/dve").Subrouter()
	sub.HandleFunc("/pod/register", h.RegisterPod).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
	sub.HandleFunc("/pod/sessions", h.ListSessions).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	sub.HandleFunc("/pod/sessions/{sessionID}", h.GetSession).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
	sub.HandleFunc("/pod/{podID}/attest", h.AttestPod).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
}

+func (h *DVEPodHandler) AttestPod(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	vars := mux.Vars(r)
+	podID := vars["podID"]
+
+	var req struct {
+		TEType      string `json:"tee_type"`
+		Measurement string `json:"measurement"`
+		PublicKey   string `json:"public_key"`
+		Signature   string `json:"signature"`
+	}
+
+	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
+		sendPodError(w, "Invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+
+	if req.TEType == "" {
+		sendPodError(w, "Missing tee_type in attestation upgrade", http.StatusBadRequest)
+		return
+	}
+
+	newTrustLevel := trustLevelFromTEType(req.TEType)
+
+	h.mu.Lock()
+	defer h.mu.Unlock()
+
+	var targetSessionID string
+	var targetSession *PodSession
+	for _, s := range h.sessions {
+		if s.NodeID == podID {
+			targetSessionID = s.SessionID
+			targetSession = s
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if targetSession == nil {
+		sendPodError(w, "Pod not found", http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
+
+	if trustLevelRank(newTrustLevel) <= trustLevelRank(targetSession.TrustLevel) {
+		sendPodError(w,
+			fmt.Sprintf("Attestation not stronger: current=%s, requested=%s", targetSession.TrustLevel, newTrustLevel),
+			http.StatusConflict)
+		return
+	}
+
+	attData, _ := json.Marshal(req)
+	targetSession.Attestation = attData
+	targetSession.TrustLevel = newTrustLevel
+

+		"trust_level": newTrustLevel,
+		"status":      "upgraded",
+	}, "Trust level upgraded successfully", http.StatusOK)
+}
+
+func trustLevelFromTEType(teeType string) string {
+	switch teeType {
+	case "sgx", "sevsnp", "sev-snp", "tdx", "nitro":
+		return "L3"
+	case "browser-wasm":
+		return "L1"
+	case "wasmer", "wasmtime", "wasi":
+		return "L0"
+	default:

+	case "L1":
+		return 1
+	case "L0":
+		return 0
+	default:
+		return -1
+	}
+}
+

 	b := make([]byte, 16)

 	return "dvepod-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)

func TestDVEPodAttestUpgrade(t *testing.T) {
	handler := web.NewDVEPodHandler("http://localhost:8084")
	require.NotNil(t, handler)

	router := mux.NewRouter()
	handler.RegisterRoutes(router)

	body := map[string]interface{}{
		"attestation": map[string]interface{}{
			"node_id":  "dvepod-attest-test",
			"tee_type": "wasmer",
		},
	}
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(body)
	req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/dve/pod/register", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, w.Code)

	var createResp struct {
		Data struct {
			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &createResp)

	attestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"tee_type":    "sgx",
		"measurement": "abcdef1234567890",
		"public_key":  "04deadbeef",
		"signature":   "signed",
	}
	attestPayload, _ := json.Marshal(attestBody)
	req2 := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/dve/pod/dvepod-attest-test/attest", bytes.NewReader(attestPayload))
	req2.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(w2, req2)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w2.Code)

	var attResp struct {
		Success bool `json:"success"`
		Data    struct {
			SessionID  string `json:"session_id"`
			NodeID     string `json:"node_id"`
			TrustLevel string `json:"trust_level"`
			Status     string `json:"status"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}
	err := json.Unmarshal(w2.Body.Bytes(), &attResp)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, attResp.Success)
	assert.Equal(t, "dvepod-attest-test", attResp.Data.NodeID)
	assert.Equal(t, "L3", attResp.Data.TrustLevel)
	assert.Equal(t, "upgraded", attResp.Data.Status)

	req3 := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/dve/pod/sessions/"+createResp.Data.SessionID, nil)
	w3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(w3, req3)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w3.Code)

	var sessionResp struct {

+func TestDVEPodAttestUpgrade(t *testing.T) {
+	handler := web.NewDVEPodHandler("http://localhost:8084")
+	require.NotNil(t, handler)
+
+	router := mux.NewRouter()
+	handler.RegisterRoutes(router)
+
+	body := map[string]interface{}{
+		"attestation": map[string]interface{}{
+			"node_id":  "dvepod-attest-test",
+			"tee_type": "wasmer",
+		},
+	}
+	payload, _ := json.Marshal(body)
+	req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/dve/pod/register", bytes.NewReader(payload))
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
+	require.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, w.Code)
+
+	var createResp struct {
+		Data struct {
+			SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
+		} `json:"data"`
+	}
+	json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &createResp)
+
+	attestBody := map[string]interface{}{
+		"tee_type":    "sgx",
+		"measurement": "abcdef1234567890",
+		"public_key":  "04deadbeef",
+		"signature":   "signed",
+	}
+	attestPayload, _ := json.Marshal(attestBody)
+	req2 := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/dve/pod/dvepod-attest-test/attest", bytes.NewReader(attestPayload))
+	req2.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	w2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	router.ServeHTTP(w2, req2)
+
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w2.Code)
+
+	var attResp struct {
+		Success bool `json:"success"`
+		Data    struct {
+			SessionID  string `json:"session_id"`
+			NodeID     string `json:"node_id"`
+			TrustLevel string `json:"trust_level"`
+			Status     string `json:"status"`
+		} `json:"data"`
+	}
+	err := json.Unmarshal(w2.Body.Bytes(), &attResp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.True(t, attResp.Success)
+	assert.Equal(t, "dvepod-attest-test", attResp.Data.NodeID)
+	assert.Equal(t, "L3", attResp.Data.TrustLevel)
+	assert.Equal(t, "upgraded", attResp.Data.Status)
+
+	req3 := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/dve/pod/sessions/"+createResp.Data.SessionID, nil)
+	w3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	router.ServeHTTP(w3, req3)
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w3.Code)
+
+	var sessionResp struct {
+		Data struct {
+			TrustLevel string `json:"trust_level"`
+		} `json:"data"`
+	}
+	json.Unmarshal(w3.Body.Bytes(), &sessionResp)
+	assert.Equal(t, "L3", sessionResp.Data.TrustLevel)
+}
+
